content.what_it_is: MATLAB extraction script for the solitary-wave-on-plane-beach measured benchmark (sph_sol_plane_mea), variant A -- same algorithm as sph_sol_plane_ana/ETA_Liner.m but with five snapshots. Loads eta_0095/0126/0157/0189/0219 (L6-16), row 2 of each as the 1D profile (d1..d5). Non-dimensional coordinate x=(6000-(i-1)*dx)/dep with dx=5, dep=100 (L20-23). Keeps -2<=x<=20 walking i=n:-1:1 (L25-38), storing eta/dep in data columns 2-6 (L31-35), then writes x into column 1 reversed (L39-43). Outputs tab-delimited FUNWAVE_BP1_SHAPE.txt precision 6 (L45).
entities: script variables: fdir @L2, dep @L4, d @L6 (reused), n @L7, d1..d5 @L8-16, dx @L21, x @L23, ii @L26, kk @L31, data @L32-43, ll @L40
unresolved: Five snapshots produce 6 data columns, but the output keeps the BP1_SHAPE filename used by the 7-snapshot analytical variant -- downstream consumers expecting 8 columns would mismatch; snapshot indices 0095..0219 map to benchmark times externally.
Row 2 of each 2D snapshot used as profile; x re-indexing via kk relies on the kept window being contiguous (monotonic x) -- same caveats as the _ana variant.
n=length(d) is the larger snapshot dimension; assumes columns exceed rows.
